lens.adaptation: The observer framing is the scene. The player can leave at any moment and the game never asks them to stay.

commands.text: A position that does not hold
Found his position from above. He had it arranged properly — lines, reliefs, a fallback. It was competent and it was not going to be enough, and both of those things were visible from where I stood.
From above, the position reads well: lines, reliefs, a fallback. It was arranged by someone who expected to be relieved.
Watched. I will not dress that word up. I was concealed, I had leaves, and I had the essence to intervene, and I chose the ridge.
It fell at dusk. He was organising a relief that no longer existed when it stopped. I came down the other side of the ridge and arrived in the village with everybody else.
Nothing about that day requires explanation, and nobody has asked for one.
